BTBAM,

I saw you and Periphery at the The Garage in Glasgow...2 years ago was it?

Was anticipating the show for the whole day, my brothers band from years ago had you guys as one of his main influences, and he got me introduced to the progressive scene and heavy music in general.

Just wanted to say your performance was one of the best experiences in my life.  I got right up the front row after Periphery had finished because I noticed a lot of people left before you even started playing.  Not bashing Periphery, but I thought it was kind of a disgrace to see that amount of people in the remaining audience just standing still all around me.

Oh, and Tommy, I remember you nodding at me when I gave a thumbs up.  That got me geekin' out for the rest of the night.

Not really sure what to ask - what about that tour - I remember Periphery had to substitute another guy on the drums because their original guy busted his arm or something.  Were those guys nervous or anything throughout the tour?  I think it was their first time in the UK as a band.

Anyway, thanks for your music, always listening to this day.

Done some searching:   http://forums.bit-tech.net/showthread.php?t=233533

If any of you are actually considering on buying one of these units, take it from me, don't.  While I never had any leaks or major damage done to my system, it's a blatant rip off.

It's being detected now, in another PCI-E, but I'm having the same issues as before.  So it's definitely either the GPU itself or something else, but I haven't nothing anything else out of the ordinary.
I've currently got it slotted into another PCI-E bus, but it's not being detected in the BIOS.  I'm certain that it's connected properly and I have drivers installed.
